title: UAC-0020 (Vermin) атакує Сили оборони України з використанням ШПЗ SPECTR в тандемі з легітимним SyncThing (кампанія "SickSync") (CERT-UA#9934)

entities.name: UAC-0020
entities.gloss: A threat actor group associated with security agencies in occupied Luhansk, also known as Vermin.

entities.name: Центр кібербезпеки ЗСУ
entities.gloss: The cybersecurity center of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.

entities.name: Сили оборони України
entities.gloss: The collective military and security forces defending Ukraine.

entities.name: Луганськ
entities.gloss: A city in eastern Ukraine temporarily occupied by Russian-backed forces.

entities.name: SPECTR
entities.gloss: A modular spyware malware family used for data theft and cyber espionage.

entities.name: SyncThing
entities.gloss: A legitimate peer-to-peer file synchronization application abused for data exfiltration.

entities.name: InnoSetup
entities.gloss: A legitimate script-driven installation system used to package Windows installers.

entities.name: SickSync
entities.gloss: A cyber espionage campaign conducted by UAC-0020 targeting Ukrainian defense forces.

entities.name: туррель.фоп.вовчок.rar
entities.gloss: A password-protected RAR archive delivered as a malicious email attachment.

entities.name: туррель.фоп.вовчок.sfx.rar.scr
entities.gloss: A malicious self-extracting RAR archive containing the initial payload components.

entities.name: Wowchok.pdf
entities.gloss: A decoy PDF document bundled within the malicious archive.

entities.name: sync.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious installer containing SyncThing components and SPECTR malware files.

entities.name: run_user.bat
entities.gloss: A batch script used to launch the initial stages of the infection.

entities.name: syncthing.exe
entities.gloss: The core executable of the SyncThing file synchronization software.

entities.name: SyncthingFirewallRule.js
entities.gloss: A JavaScript script used to configure firewall rules for SyncThing.

entities.name: SetSyncthingConfig.js
entities.gloss: A JavaScript script used to configure SyncThing settings.

entities.name: SyncthingLogonTask.js
entities.gloss: A JavaScript script used to create persistence tasks for SyncThing.

entities.name: ConfigSyncthingService.js
entities.gloss: A JavaScript script used to configure the SyncThing service.

entities.name: StartSyncthing.js
entities.gloss: A JavaScript script executed to launch the SyncThing application.

entities.name: startps.exe
entities.gloss: An executable component used in the deployment chain of SPECTR.

entities.name: nssm.exe
entities.gloss: Non-Sucking Service Manager, a utility used to manage Windows services.

entities.name: SpecMon
entities.gloss: A core module of SPECTR malware responsible for loading plugin DLLs.

entities.name: PluginLoader.dll
entities.gloss: A SPECTR DLL component responsible for executing IPlugin DLL modules.

entities.name: Screengrabber
entities.gloss: A SPECTR module that captures screenshots of specific application windows.

entities.name: FileGrabber
entities.gloss: A SPECTR module that steals documents and files from specified directories.

entities.name: Usb
entities.gloss: A SPECTR module that copies targeted file types from removable USB drives.

entities.name: Social
entities.gloss: A SPECTR module that steals authentication data from messenger applications.

entities.name: Browsers
entities.gloss: A SPECTR module that extracts session data, credentials, and history from web browsers.

entities.name: syncthing.net
entities.gloss: The official domain and infrastructure for the SyncThing file synchronization software.

entities.name: crash.syncthing.net
entities.gloss: A subdomain of SyncThing used for crash reporting infrastructure.

entities.name: data.syncthing.net
entities.gloss: A subdomain of SyncThing used for data synchronization infrastructure.

entities.name: upgrades.syncthing.net
entities.gloss: A subdomain of SyncThing used for update distribution infrastructure.

entities.name: csoc@post.mil.gov.ua
entities.gloss: An official contact email address for the Cyber Security Center of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
